title: Miriam
sourceLines: -Watched over Moses when he was in the little basket Ex 2:4-8
-Song of, after the destruction of Pharaoh and his army Ex 15:20,21; Mic 6:4
-Jealous of Moses, stricken with leprosy, healed on account of the intercession of Moses Nu 12; De 24:9
-Died and is buried at Kadesh Nu 20:1
